title: Testing a Zero application
summary: Assertions on Result whose failure messages name the actual errors, a harness that runs one handler through the real pipeline, a recording ISender, and a test application whose container validates scopes and registrations exactly as startup does. References no test runner, so it works with any of them.
useWhen: Writing any test for code built on Zero. Do not hand-build a RequestRegistry, a RequestEntry, a pipeline lambda or a service provider in a test, and do not write your own Result assertion helper or fake sender.
notes: The only capability with no AddZero... method: it is referenced by test projects and never takes part in the application's own container.
